answer.rationale: Switching primary supply is the clearest path to the mandated cut but is not compatible with a 14-day expiry, no auto-renew, and a line at 94% with no buffer. Renewing unchanged protects delivery but forfeits the cost mandate. Because the refusal is price-specific, the least-risk TCO move is to keep the incumbent as primary while using renewal leverage on term length, volume commitment, payment terms, rebates, freight, and inventory obligations. I want memory_c6 verified because it is the main support for incumbent multi-year/volume levers; memory_c1 supports continuity and memory_c4 supports benchmarking leverage, but c6 is most decision-critical.
